routes.name: Facebook
routes.reportLabel: Report a Violation of your Privacy on Facebook
routes.scope: Meta's form covers photos or videos of you that violate your privacy. Text posts that expose personal information are reported with the Report link on the post or profile.
routes.verifiedVia: Loaded in a browser: the help article 'Report a photo or video on Facebook that violates my privacy' (help/327689333983073) links help/contact/516343134409068, which redirects to help/contact/1478481359703190, titled 'Report a Violation of your Privacy on Facebook'. The previously circulated form IDs 144059062408922 and 143363852478561 returned Not Found.

routes.name: Instagram / Threads
routes.reportLabel: Report a Violation of your Privacy on Instagram or Threads
routes.scope: Meta's form covers photos or videos of you on Instagram or Threads. You need the link to the content. Other exposed private information is reported from the post or profile.
routes.verifiedVia: Loaded in a browser: the help article 'Exposed Private Information' (122717417885747) links contact/512241091300432 ('report it to us'), which redirects to contact/1024543072377373, titled 'Report a Violation of your Privacy on Instagram or Threads'.

routes.name: X (Twitter)
routes.scope: X's private information policy: private information or private media shared without permission. X may need to hear from the person the information belongs to (or an authorized representative).
routes.verifiedVia: Loaded in a browser: page titled 'Private Information' on help.x.com renders a report form ('The content being shared on X belongs to'). Policy page 'Private information policy | X Help Center' loaded.

routes.name: LinkedIn
routes.scope: LinkedIn's form for personal-data and privacy concerns (including data subject rights). Fake or impersonating profiles are reported from the profile; see LinkedIn Help 'Report fake profiles' (answer/a1338436).
routes.verifiedVia: Loaded in a browser while signed out: 'Contact form | LinkedIn Help', heading 'Contacting LinkedIn's Data Protection Officer', for 'matters related to your personal LinkedIn data and privacy concerns'.

routes.name: TikTok
routes.reportLabel: TikTok privacy request / report a privacy violation
routes.scope: TikTok's privacy request page: ask about your data, report a privacy violation, or raise a specific privacy issue. Continue leads to the request form.
routes.verifiedVia: Fetched (HTTP 200): page heading 'Request privacy information', offering 'report a privacy violation'.

routes.name: YouTube
routes.reportLabel: YouTube privacy complaint (Report a privacy issue)
routes.scope: YouTube's privacy complaint process: you must be uniquely identifiable in the content. Only URLs and timestamps are shared with the uploader.
routes.verifiedVia: Fetched (HTTP 200): page titled 'Report a privacy issue - YouTube Help'; linked from the 'Privacy Complaint Process' help article.

routes.name: Reddit
routes.scope: Reddit's report form for Reddit Rules violations, including posting someone's private or personal information. Reddit says this form is for people with a Reddit account; without one, use the Reddit Help 'Submit a request' page.
routes.verifiedVia: Fetched (HTTP 200); linked as 'this report form' from Reddit Help 'Submit a request' (support.reddithelp.com/hc/en-us/requests/new), which was loaded in a browser.

routes.name: Pinterest
routes.reportLabel: Pinterest Help contact form (Report policy violation → Report exposed personal information)
routes.scope: Pinterest's Non-User Notice points people to this form (report policy violation; report exposed personal information) to ask for removal of a personal image or exposed information.
routes.verifiedVia: Loaded in a browser: Pinterest 'Non-User Notice' links 'form' to help.pinterest.com/contact; that URL returns HTTP 200 ('Contact Pinterest support | Pinterest Help').
